stations.title: Mira
stations.say: Sum up the cake stand case.

stations.title: Agents
stations.text: Read the summary, not the complaint.

captions: At Kestrel Parcels, Mira's team reads a Kes summary of each complaint.
The cake stand summary stops mid-sentence, and nothing says so.
You catch it, fix it and write the test, in three tasks.
Now the cake stand summary reaches the agents in full.
Same complaint, whole summary. And a test keeps it that way.
